name: Clockify
label: Clockify API
description: Clockify API v1 via OfficialApiNode. Base https://{region_host}/api/v1. Default region_host api.clockify.me; EU Germany euc1.clockify.me; USA use2.clockify.me; UK euw2.clockify.me; AU apse2.clockify.me (https://docs.clockify.me/). X-Api-Key auth. OUTPUT is {status, http_status, data} or {error}. Inbound webhooks: selecting the :listen operation (listen) via webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) blocks the canvas INPUT port and compiles as a webhook-triggered Message Start (or binds to any Activity's MESSAGE Boundary Event).
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One Clockify official API call. Delivered as inputVariables.input. Set operation plus the path/query/body fields that operation lists in api_spec.json. Do not put secrets on this port. Example: {"operation":"project_create"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official HTTP verb to run. Overrides instance operation when non-blank. EXACT accepted values: 'project_create', 'project_get', 'project_list', 'project_update', 'project_delete', 'tag_create', 'tag_list', 'tag_update', 'tag_delete', 'task_create', 'task_get', 'task_list', 'task_update', 'task_delete', 'time_entry_create', 'time_entry_get', 'time_entry_update', 'time_entry_delete', 'listen'. listen (:listen role) is configured on the node via webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) for inbound webhooks (blocks the canvas INPUT port). Example: 'project_create'.

schema.description: Request field for operations that declare `workspace_id` as a path, query, or JSON body key. Omitted/blank is dropped. Example: 'example-value'.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Handler result object. Success: status='ok', http_status, data (parsed JSON). Example: {"status":"ok","http_status":200,"data":{}}. Inbound webhook events (:listen) emit normalized event data on output. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Present on HTTP 2xx. EXACT value: 'ok'. Example: 'ok'.

schema.label: HTTP status
schema.description: Provider HTTP status code. Example: 200.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the official API, or the raw string when not JSON. Example: {}.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default official API call for this instance when input.operation is blank. EXACT accepted values: project_create, project_get, project_list, project_update, project_delete, tag_create, tag_list, tag_update, tag_delete, task_create, task_get, task_list, task_update, task_delete, time_entry_create, time_entry_get, time_entry_update, time_entry_delete, listen. Default: project_create. Selecting listen (:listen role) reveals webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef), blocks the canvas INPUT port, and compiles as a webhook-triggered Message Start or Activity MESSAGE Boundary Event. Example: project_create.

configurationParameters.label: Api Key
configurationParameters.description: Provider credential for auth.type=header (configKey api_key). REQUIRED secret — StudioQuack secret binding only; never put this on INPUT. Never logged. Example: 'redacted-token'.

configurationParameters.label: Region host
configurationParameters.description: Clockify API host without scheme. Default api.clockify.me. EU: euc1.clockify.me. USA: use2.clockify.me. UK: euw2.clockify.me. AU: apse2.clockify.me. Subdomain workspaces use {subdomain}.clockify.me. https://clockify.me/help/getting-started/data-regions

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout for the official HTTPS call. Positive integer. Blank/0/negative → 25. Example: 25.

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Key
configurationParameters.description: Engine Webhook API Key binding ($webhookKeyRef) routing inbound HTTP webhooks to this node.
